name: Aoya Toboso
source:
While seemingly always happy, cheerful, and outgoing, she rarely talks about anything serious, let alone about herself. She often uses her "demon eye" joke to get away from serious topics.

She's been [url=/c24086]Yuuki's[/url] classmate for about a year, and they've been close friends ever since.

[Based on the [url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/cyclet_pro/dasaku/character05.html]official description[/url]]
